purpose: Editorial cases for human or agent evaluation; structural tests do not establish these decisions.

cases.prompt: add mobile synchronization after suspension and network recovery.

cases.prompt: add mobile synchronization after suspension and network recovery. The project already has an implementation and evidence of this capability, but no dedicated document.
